export_batch_mapping.shape_change: None; no simplification or welding occurs during LOD0 batching

export_options.axis_note: Blender +Y maps to glTF and Godot -Z under the exporter's +Y-up conversion; a vehicle authored nose-at-+Y therefore faces Godot forward. The v1 profile's -Y claim placed the Hero GT nose at +Z, opposite the physics front axle. Sedan specialization retains every v3 exporter option and only changes asset identity.

evaluated_uv_bake.policy: Exact source, JSON, layout and all non-UV bytes must match the reviewed bake; restore only bounded evaluated UV float variation. Explicit new bake required after source edits.
